supersedes: sobol_slice_v1.csv (b016adc), superseded 2026-10-21 before any run: one kymin per point gave no gamma_max or spectrum, and 192 equilibria was too many
purpose: independent grading slice for the VURS campaign; post-draft test
extension_rule: Run wave 2 (points 8-15 per shot) only if, after wave 1, the pooled 95% interval half-width on the Stage 1 primary score exceeds the threshold set in the comparison manifest before wave-1 grading (proposed 0.15 on the label-agreement rate). The rule reads interval width only, never which sampler leads.
radius: wave 1 at the Te_top Chapman radius; ne_top / steep optional on the same equilibria
